units.function: Embedded-Postgres route tests for per-human Work inbox archive/unarchive, completion-triggered archive, transactional audit, Agent delegation/attribution and activity-based resurfacing.
units.dependencyDirection: Supertest/Express issue routes -> real policy/access/issue/archive/activity/live-event services -> Drizzle/PostgreSQL; actor authentication and grant issuance are outside the unit.
units.keyDataModels: Work, per-user InboxArchive, human/Agent actor and on-behalf-of membership, heartbeat Run/responsible user, delegation policy, scoped Agent permission grant, activity and live event.
units.lifecycle: Resolve target human -> evaluate policy/trust/scoped grant -> idempotently archive/unarchive with actor/Run attribution -> filter archived projection -> resurface after newer activity; board done mutation archives transactionally with audit.
units.testAssessment: All 7 tests skipped in sandboxed and approved unsandboxed runs due unavailable embedded PostgreSQL. Source cases demonstrate sophisticated projection/transaction semantics but do not execute locally and omit policy/grant version races, grant issuance provenance and outbox durability.
units.designRationale: Keep inbox tidying personal and reversible, avoid letting an Agent's business completion silently hide a human's item, preserve attribution and automatically bring Work back when new activity makes the archive stale.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs human-owned responsibility/approval queues whose presentation state is reversible and auditable, while delegated Agent assistance remains subordinate to explicit human refusal and exact action authorization.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT authority precedence while ADAPTing per-user projection, idempotency, done/audit transaction, Agent-vs-human completion distinction, stable denials and activity-based resurfacing. Human disabled must be a hard deny unless a separately governed emergency legal policy with reason, notice and human approval applies; bind delegation/grant versions and use transactional outbox events.
units.responsibilityConflict: A scoped Agent grant overrides the target human's disabled policy and records only grant_override, not the grantor, accountable approver, reason or policy basis. Agent/Run attribution is useful but incomplete without ResponsibilityContract, exact action digest and immutable delegation evidence.
units.securityFindings: CRITICAL consent override: Agent inbox:manage grant supersedes a human disabled policy. HIGH grant provenance gap: grantor/version/reason/expiry and accountable approval are not in the receipt. HIGH race gap: policy/grant revocation, new activity and repeated archive concurrency are untested. HIGH identity gap: actor/on-behalf-of construction is injected and stale/forged Run responsibility is not challenged. MEDIUM event gap: live event durability/outbox is not proven. MEDIUM verification gap: all database tests skipped locally.
